optionalClient.adds: character filter, controlled value, onChange, onComplete

breaking: value, onChange (value: string) and onComplete moved to OtpInput from otp-input-client; the base OtpInput is a Server Component and submits the code via name
pattern is now string | RegExp describing one character; RegExp flags are ignored (use [a-zA-Z0-9] instead of /i)
the base version does not drop disallowed characters while typing; the pattern attribute marks the field :user-invalid instead
cell size is the --otp-cell CSS variable; size-* in cellClassName no longer moves the characters
the code text is drawn by the input: text styles (font size, uppercase) go on className or [&_input], not cellClassName
the single active-cell ring is replaced by a focus color on all cells plus the native caret
new prop attempt replays the error shake while status stays error

how.en: One input with letter-spacing over CSS cells, no JavaScript
how.ru: Один input с межбуквенным интервалом над CSS-ячейками, без JavaScript
